output.summary: KEP-2067 proposes renaming the kubeadm node-role label and taint key from node-role.kubernetes.io/master to node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane, applied with a deprecation policy rather than a hard rename. Status is implementable, stage alpha.
output.rationale: The Kubernetes project is moving away from the word "master" and a naming proposal recommends "control plane" instead. The KEP therefore changes the key kubeadm sets on control plane Nodes, both as a label and as a taint. Its goals include applying deprecation policies and notifying users, and it explicitly avoids a hard rename within a single release.

alternatives.option: Hard rename of the master label and taint keys to control-plane within a single release
alternatives.why_not: Listed as a non-goal; the KEP instead aims to apply proper deprecation policies to minimize friction with users.

evidence.quote: Currently this label key is `node-role.kubernetes.io/master` and it should be renamed to `node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane`.
The Kubernetes project is moving away from wording that is considered offensive.
Apply proper deprecation policies to minimize friction with users facing the change.
Hard rename the kubeadm "master" label and taint keys to "control-plane" within a single release.
